core.title: Stainless Steel Pioneer Appliance Pull, First Impressions AP-PNR150SMTS4

text.description_html:
First Impressions AP-PNR150SMTS4, Stainless Steel Pioneer Refrigerator Handle

This Contemporary Stainless Steel Appliance Pull comes with everything you'll need to install it on a refrigerator. The Stainless Steel Pioneer Appliance Pull is great as not only a refrigerator handle, but it can be installed on any kitchen appliance that has a front panel such as the dishwasher or oven. It is available in 18 inch, 24 inch, and 36 inch lengths. Don't forget to order 2 so your freezer and refrigerator will have matching handles!

Also Available Matching Pioneer Door Pull

Specifications of the First Impressions PNR150SMTS4 Pioneer Collection Appliance Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thru-Bolts
  • First Impressions AP-PNR150SMTS4 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Available in 3 Sizes:

    AP-PNR150018SMTS4:
    • Total Length: 18"
    • Center to Center Mount: 12"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 3.19"
    • Clearance: 1.68"

    AP-PNR150024SMTS4:
    • Total Length: 24"
    • Center to Center Mount: 18"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 3.19"
    • Clearance: 1.68"

    AP-PNR150036SMTS4:
    • Total Length: 36"
    • Center to Center Mount: 24"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 3.19"
    • Clearance: 1.68"

Note: This door pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 8 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Sold individually
